facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mr. McGregor shouted at Peter. Peter was very scared. He ran and ran. He ran away fast.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mr. McGregor chased Peter through the garden. Peter ran past the carrots and the cabbages. His little heart was beating so hard. His legs hurt but he could not stop. He ran away fast and did not look back. Finally, Mr. McGregor fell behind.
facts.Word cards: ran = 달렸다 / away = 도망쳐서 / fast = 빠르게 🆕 / heart = 심장
